output: Hypothesis: The peak of Axes & Celts in the archaeological record occurred in the 32nd century BCE, as indicated by the maximum interpolated Z values in the `AxesCelts_inter` column of the `time_series_data.csv` dataset and corroborated by the `ZBeil` column in the `capital.csv` dataset. The variables chosen are the Z values for Axes & Celts (`AxesCelts_inter` and `ZBeil`), and the relationship between these variables and the Common Era (CE) or Before Common Era (BCE) indicates a peak in the 32nd century BCE. This conclusion is supported by the statistical analysis of the maximum values in the relevant columns.
